description: Get or set OSS Autopilot configuration values. With no args, shows all config. With key and value, sets the value. diffToolCustomCommand and diffTool=custom cannot be set here: the user sets them in a terminal.

key.description: Configuration key to get or set. Must be one of the known keys (derived from @oss-autopilot/core config-registry). Examples: "username", "languages", "minStars". Run the tool with no args to see all current config.

value.description: Value to set for the given key. Omit to read the current value.

name: config
